header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Pledge their Allegiance at the Hands of the Khulafaa (RA)

blocks.text: Hadhrat Miswar (RA) says, "Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) once came to me after some portion of the night had already passed and knocked at the door until I awoke. He then said to me, 'I see that you were sleeping peacefully. By Allaah! I have hardly had any sleep the entire night. Go and call Zubayr and Sa'd.' After I had called them and he had consulted with them, he called me and said, 'Call Ali.' When I had called for Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) spoke to him in confidence until half the night had passed. When Hadhrat Ali (RA) left Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA), he seemed hopeful (of becoming the Khalifah) but Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) seemed to fear something about (appointing) Hadhrat Ali (RA). Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) then asked me to call Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA). When I called him, he spoke to him in private until the Mu'adhin separated them with the Fajr Adhaan."

Hadhrat Miswar (RA) narrates further that after the Fajr salaah was completed, the group (of six Sahabah (RA)) gathered around the pulpit. Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) then sent for all the Muhaajireen and Ansaar who were present and for the leaders of all the groups that had accompanied Hadhrat Umar (RA) on that year's Hajj. When everyone had gathered, Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) recited the Shahaadah and then said, "O Ali! I have looked deeply at the opinions of the people and they all do not see anyone equal to Uthmaan. Please do not harbour anything in your heart." Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) then took hold of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s hand and said, "I pledge allegiance to you according to manner shown by Allaah, His Rasool ﷺ and the two Khalifahs (RA) after him." Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) then pledged his allegiance to Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) after which the people pledged; (first) the Muhaajireen, (followed by) the Ansaar, the leaders of the armed forces and then the Muslim public.[^1]
Bukhari. Bayhaqi (Vol.8 Pg.147) has also reported a similar narration.
